title: The quotation in the React builder
caption: The quotation starter in the React builder, and beside it the Preview: the PDF the runtime and the renderer print from the same session, down to “Total CHF 3'143.00” ([0010](./docs/decisions/0010-the-runtime-resolves-a-report-into-a-renderer-neutral-document.md), [0011](./docs/decisions/0011-report-render-pdf-draws-the-document-and-refuses-what-it-cannot.md)).
alt: The Studio: the starter picker on Quotation and the builder switch on React, the React builder with “Image: logo” first in its outline, and the Preview, “Preview: printed.”, with the quotation on white paper.

title: The sales report and its charts
caption: The sales report, its bar chart selected as “Chart (by-category)”. Each bar's label is its product line's total in the table, “63'482.00” over “Total Heizung CHF 63'482.00”, and each legend entry a region's total and share, as “Stadt Bern: 38'209.70 (30.6%)”. The builders do not edit a chart's own properties yet ([0067](./docs/decisions/0067-a-monthly-sales-report-is-a-starter-whose-bar-chart-and-pie-print-the-totals-its-table-prints.md), [0058](./docs/decisions/0058-the-renderer-lays-a-chart-out-with-apache-echarts-and-prints-its-marks-and-its-words-where-echarts-placed-them.md)).
alt: The builder with the sales report's bar chart selected, beside the Preview printing its first page: a bar chart, a pie with its legend, and the month's lines.

title: The product data sheet in French
caption: The product data sheet switched to French in the builder's bar, “Showing the words in French (Switzerland).”, and the Preview printing it in French, from “Fiche technique” to “Caractéristiques techniques”. A word missing in a language refuses that language's render ([0063](./docs/decisions/0063-a-reports-own-words-are-written-in-each-language-it-declares-and-a-render-names-the-one-it-prints-in.md), [0061](./docs/decisions/0061-a-paragraphs-run-may-be-set-below-or-above-the-line-in-any-character-its-face-draws-and-prints-only-beside-a-run-on-the-line.md)).
alt: The builder showing the product data sheet's words in French, beside the Preview printing the sheet in French.

title: The XRechnung and its XML
caption: The XRechnung starter, “E-invoice (XRechnung)”, its e-invoice selected, “XRechnung: E-invoice”, and Final on. Its PDF says at the top of every page “Copy of an XRechnung: the invoice is its XML, and this PDF is not the invoice”; “Download XML” gives the invoice, and “Download Word” the copy ([0038](./docs/decisions/0038-a-reports-e-invoice-may-be-an-xrechnung-3-0-whose-xml-a-host-takes-and-whose-pdf-is-its-labelled-copy.md), [0065](./docs/decisions/0065-the-xrechnung-is-a-starter-beside-the-e-invoice-and-a-final-render-of-either-offers-its-xml-beside-its-pdf.md), [0077](./docs/decisions/0077-a-report-that-carries-an-e-invoice-is-written-into-a-word-file-as-the-copy-the-runtime-labels-on-every-page.md)).
alt: The Studio with the XRechnung open and its e-invoice's terms in the builder's properties, beside the Preview with Final on, offering Download PDF, Download XML and Download Word.

title: Download Word
caption: The invoice's Preview: “Download PDF” gives the PDF, and “Download Word” a Word file of the same document, the QR-bill's slip a page of its own. Word lays out its lines and pages; this file was opened in Word once, by hand, on 20 November 2026, and no test opens one ([0068](./docs/decisions/0068-a-report-is-written-as-a-word-file-by-a-writer-of-its-own-and-what-belongs-to-its-pdf-is-refused.md), [0075](./docs/decisions/0075-a-qr-bills-slip-is-written-into-a-word-file-on-a-page-of-its-own-and-every-line-of-it-is-shown-to-fit.md)). Every starter's files are in [samples](./samples/README.md).
alt: The Preview of the invoice starter, with Download PDF and Download Word above the invoice and its QR-bill.

title: The order confirmation's tables
caption: The order confirmation's services table, “Table (services)”, selected with its condition `row.kind == "service"`: one list of lines printed as three tables, each with its own total, the goods grouped by delivery, as “Zwischensumme Lieferung CHF 15'965.75” ([0062](./docs/decisions/0062-a-report-holds-several-tables-over-its-detail-rows-each-printing-and-totalling-the-rows-its-condition-selects.md), [0064](./docs/decisions/0064-an-order-confirmation-and-a-product-data-sheet-are-starters-that-print-what-0059-to-0063-added.md)).
alt: The builder with the order confirmation's services table selected and its condition in the properties, beside the Preview printing the order's first page.

title: The payment reminder's QR-bill
caption: The payment reminder's QR-bill, “QR-bill: Payment part”, selected and edited field by field; the builder warns that “the payment part's account is SIX's example (IG 2.4, Annex A), no one's: replace it before the bill is sent”, and the Preview prints “Zu bezahlen CHF 3'207.30” above the slip ([0066](./docs/decisions/0066-a-payment-reminder-is-a-starter-that-pays-the-balance-of-a-customers-overdue-invoices-by-a-qr-bill-in-the-customers-language.md), [0039](./docs/decisions/0039-a-person-selects-a-reports-qr-bill-and-edits-it-field-by-field-in-either-builder.md)).
alt: The builder with the payment reminder's payment part selected and its fields open, beside the Preview printing the reminder and its QR-bill.

title: The same session in the Angular builder
caption: The quotation's payment line edited in React to “Zahlbar innert 10 Tagen netto.”, then the switch moved to Angular: the same session, so the edit is there, still selected, with its Undo ([0012](./docs/decisions/0012-the-builders-are-native-and-share-one-session.md)).
alt: The Angular builder with the edited line “Zahlbar innert 10 Tagen netto.” selected, beside the Preview printing it.

title: A diagnostic
caption: The equipment register's Category column set to show the description: the builder warns before anything renders, “field "category" of the detail dataset is neither printed, drawn, ordered by, totalled nor read, and would be fetched for nothing”, and the Preview still prints, “Basel (12 items)” heading its group ([0009](./docs/decisions/0009-an-expression-is-checked-and-bound-member-by-member.md)).
alt: The builder with the equipment register's Category column selected and a warning in its problems, beside the Preview printing the register grouped by site.

title: A refusal linked to its component
caption: The Book value column given the condition `row.value > 1000`: the runtime refuses to print rather than guess, “Preview: refused by the runtime, 1 problem.”, saying why, “row has a value only in a table's cells and what an aggregate reads from each row”, and “Select Book value” takes the keyboard to the column ([0010](./docs/decisions/0010-the-runtime-resolves-a-report-into-a-renderer-neutral-document.md)).
alt: The builder with the Book value column selected and an error in its problems, beside the Preview refusing to print, with its reason and a button “Select Book value”.

title: At a phone's width
caption: At 390 pixels wide, the Studio as it opens, on the invoice: one pane at a time, the Preview in the design view's place, “Page 1 of 1”. Nothing scrolls sideways down to 320 pixels, which the browser gate measures ([0029](./docs/decisions/0029-the-preview-stands-in-the-design-views-place-where-it-does-not-fit-beside-the-builder.md), [0082](./docs/decisions/0082-the-studio-opens-on-the-invoice-and-lists-it-first-and-the-corpus-keeps-its-order.md)).
alt: The Studio at a phone's width: the bar's controls a line each, the picker on Invoice, and the builder showing the Preview as its one pane, “Preview: printed.”, with the invoice's page down to its total, its QR-bill below, out of the picture.
